name: Wrist flexor stretch
summary: Arm straight out, palm up, pull the fingers gently back toward you.
setup: Straighten the arm in front, palm up. With the other hand, draw the fingers back toward the body until the front of the forearm stretches. Hold.
why: The stretch is at the hand. Logged by hand.

faults.label: Elbow bending
faults.tip: A bent elbow takes the stretch off the forearm.

faults.label: Bouncing the stretch
faults.tip: A steady hold lengthens the tissue; bouncing just provokes it.

faults.label: Fingers not included
faults.tip: Straightening the fingers as well reaches the whole flexor group.

points.t: Straight, palm up, fingers drawn back.
